input.$description: Single-line text field. One fill only: surface-0 (page) background with a surface-6 (outline.strong) hairline border — the field recedes into the page at rest and lifts to a surface-4 filled look on hover. sm has no floating label — the placeholder simply vanishes on focus/when typing, same text stays 16px throughout. base/lg float the placeholder into a 10px label above the value on focus or once populated. Value/placeholder text is 16px at every size, deliberately — Safari on iOS auto-zooms the page on focus if an input's font-size is under 16px, so going smaller would trigger that on every mobile focus.

sm.$description: 32px. No floating label — the box isn't tall enough to hold a 10px label + 16px value stacked and still read as anything but cramped. Placeholder disappears the moment the field is focused or has a value, same as a plain unlabeled input.

base.$description: 40px, the default size. Floating label: 10px, sitting directly above the 16px value with 0 gap between their line-boxes and 2px from the stack to the field's own top/bottom edges — vertically centered via flexbox rather than hand-computed padding, since 10px/16px text at leading.tight doesn't sum to a value that divides evenly into 40px, and flex-centering doesn't need it to.

lg.$description: 48px. Same 10px floating label as base, but with 4px between the label and value line-boxes and 4px from the stack to the field's top/bottom edges — more breathing room at the larger size. Same flex-centering approach as base.

default.$description: Empty, not focused. surface.page (surface-0, the darkest page surface) fill + outline.strong (surface-6) hairline border — the field reads as recessed into the page rather than raised off it.

hover.$description: Fills to the raised surface (surface-4) with the border blended into that same fill, so the field lifts into a solid filled look on hover instead of merely darkening its outline — the sportsbook 'lighten on hover' move applied to a recessed field.

active.$description: The field is being edited (pointer/click focus). Fill stays surface-0; the border turns the active accent (outline.active) and a same-accent text caret blinks in the value as text is typed. The floating label stays grey (text.secondary) — only the border and caret signal 'active', not the label. Distinct from 'focused', the keyboard-focus ring.

focused.$description: Keyboard focus (:focus-visible) — the active look plus an additive brand-blue ring offset from the field, the same focus indicator used on Button/Checkbox/etc. Composes on top of the active border/label; a mouse click gives the active state without the ring.

populated.$description: Has a value, not focused — the base/lg floating label stays up (that's a layout state, not a color one) but every color reverts to default. Named 'populated' rather than 'filled' to avoid colliding with the unrelated fill.* token family.

disabled.$description: Disabled swaps to surface.disabled (the card surface); the disabled cue is the text/label fading out, not a background shift — same pattern as the secondary button's fill.disabled.

error.$description: Red border on the field itself (outline.negative) plus a red helper/error line below it (text.negative) — the message element is part of the error state, not a separate component.
